clock_policy: Absolute due values are fixed. Upstream LAST-MODIFIED records actual execution time and is not compared byte-for-byte across runs.

results.observation: Normal CLI edit persists due value and increments SEQUENCE; a new CLI process and SQLite cache agree.
Malformed date returns exit 2 and leaves the calendar file byte-identical.
A stale Todo object overwrites a newer due date without a version-conflict error.
results.claim_falsified: SEQUENCE alone prevents stale-writer lost updates.

results.observation: A date-only due value is accepted and persisted as an all-day date, without a UTC instant.
results.claim_falsified: Every accepted Todoman deadline meets A2 explicit-instant semantics.

results.observation: Configuration is executable Python; a harmless synthetic marker is written during load_config.
results.claim_falsified: A Todoman configuration file is inert data safe to accept from an untrusted source.

results.observation: An explicitly missing configuration produces exit 1 and actionable error text.

scope: Local CLI and model characterization, not authentication, LMS integration, performance, or network security assurance.
